title: fix(app-shell): Studio's flow value maps write a literal or a CEL value envelope, and more text slots use {{ }} holes (objectui#12101)
body:
Fixes #12101
Clause-②: no

Studio stops writing the single-brace `{var}` token in the flow fields where the installed `@objectstack/spec` (`18.0.0-next.0`) refuses it. This follows ADR-0032 Decision 2 (a value slot holds a CEL value envelope `{ dialect: 'cel', source }` or a literal) and Decision 3 ("One delimiter, `{{ }}`; single `{ }` deleted."). It covers S1 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939 pass 4 (subflow `input`, script `inputs`) and the findings carried in comment 6163229107 (screen `defaults`, notify `actionUrl`, http `url` / `headers`). It reuses the `refMode: 'hole'` mode from objectui#11824 (PR #12355) and adds no second mode.

## Measured first: per-site table on the installed spec

Instrument: `safeParse` of each node's config schema from `@objectstack/spec/automation` as installed (`18.0.0-next.0`), plus that node's rows in `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS` / `FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS`. Spellings tried: `{x}`, `{{ x }}`, `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'x' }`, a literal.

| Site | Spec row on next.0 | `{x}` | Prescribed spelling | Here |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| subflow `input.*` (S1) | value | refused | envelope or literal | **converted** |
| script `inputs.*` (S1) | value | refused | envelope or literal | **converted** |
| screen `defaults.*` (carried) | value | refused | envelope or literal | **converted** |
| notify `actionUrl` (carried, S4) | text slot | refused | `{{ }}` hole | **converted** |
| http `url` (carried, S5) | text slot | refused | `{{ }}` hole | **converted** |
| http `headers` values (carried, S5) | text slot, `eachValue` | refused | `{{ }}` hole | **converted** |
| map `input.*` (S1) | value | refused | envelope or literal | no Studio field, nothing to change |
| loop / map `collection` (S3) | value | refused (a bare string too) | envelope or list | held for a split |
| get / update / delete_record `filter` operands (S6) | value, `filterOperands` | refused | envelope or literal | held for a split |
| notify `sourceId`, `templateData.*` (S4) | value | refused | envelope or literal | held for a split |
| http `body` (S5) | value | refused | envelope or literal | held for a split |
| screen `recordId`, `fields[].defaultValue` | value | refused | envelope or literal | held for a split |

Each of the six converted sites also accepts the spelling Studio now writes: an envelope or a literal on the value maps, and `{{ x }}` on the text slots. The new test file pins that against the installed spec.

**Every site in the thread is installable on next.0.** The pointer comments say S3 to S6 landed on objectstack `main` after the cut. The rows and refusals are already in the published `18.0.0-next.0` tarball, so no site is "not yet installable". The held rows are held because of the dispatch's stop condition (the S1 pair plus the carried slots make one PR), not because the spec lacks them. They are listed for the seat to split.

**Part of the premise was already true.** Since objectui#12030 moved to next.0, the key/value editor reads `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS`. It already offered the text / CEL-expression toggle on subflow `input`, script `inputs` and screen `defaults`. It already showed the spec's refusal under a stored `{token}`, and that refusal names the token's CEL spelling: "Write `{account.id}` as { dialect: 'cel', source: 'account.id' }". What was still wrong: the text cell's reference picker inserted `{var}`, and the help text taught `{var}`.

**Simulator:** the Debug run does not resolve these maps. `subflow` is in its unsupported set, and `script` is mocked without reading `inputs`. So nothing changes there.

## What changed

- **Value maps (`FlowKeyValueField`).** In a value-role map, a text cell is a literal and has no reference picker, because the picker could only produce a token the spec refuses there. The same reasoning made the notify recipients' Other row literal in objectui#11824. A reference is written by switching the value to an expression; that cell's picker inserts the bare reference, and the cell stores an envelope. The template scope note under a value-role text cell is gone, since a literal has no holes.
  - This is one code path. It also reaches the other value-role maps the ledger names (the assignment node's map, and the create / update_record `fields` maps), whose text-cell picker inserted the same refused `{var}`. Same defect class, same file, same gates.
- **Help text, en and zh:** subflow Input mapping, script Inputs and screen Form defaults now say "a literal, or a CEL expression". Nothing teaches `{var}` any more.
- **Text slots:** notify Click-through URL and http URL get `refMode: 'hole'`. http Headers (a key/value map whose every value is a text slot) also carries `refMode: 'hole'`. `FlowNodeConfigField` passes it to the editor as `valueMode: 'hole'`. Each header value cell's picker inserts `{{ x }}`, and `FlowExprIssue` gains a `hole` role. That role flags a single brace with the `{{ }}` fix and scans only each hole's variable path, which is the same check a single text slot runs since objectui#11824. `mergeServerFlowFields` already carries `hole` onto a served field of the same key, so this holds online too. Help, en and zh: "Renders {{ }} holes".
- The objectui#11824 pin "the hole-mode set is exactly the five" now asserts that the five are in the set and that every hole field is a spec text slot. The full set is pinned in the new file.

## Pins: `flowValueSlots-12101.test.tsx`

- The installed spec refuses `{x}` at all six sites and accepts the spelling written here.
- The hole-mode set equals the `FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS` rows the designer renders. The designer's `http_request` group is the spec's `http` node.
- Served http `url` / `headers` keep hole mode.
- notify `actionUrl` and http `url`: the picker inserts `{{ customer }}`.
- Each of the three value maps:
  - its text cell has no picker;
  - toggling a cell writes an envelope, and the expression picker writes `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'customer' }`;
  - a stored `{account.id}` shows the refusal containing its CEL spelling.
- Header value: the picker inserts `{{ customer }}`, a `{record.id}` is flagged with `{{ record.id }}`, and a hole is clean.
- No help text or placeholder of the six fields, en or zh, matches a single-brace token.

**Ablation**, with the fix committed. The five implementation files were reverted to the base `ccd7e94` and the mutation was checked on disk (`valueMode` count 0 in `FlowKeyValueField.tsx`). Result: `Tests 11 failed | 13 passed (24)`. The 13 that stay green are the spec measurements and the stored-token refusals, which already held on base (above). Restore: `git checkout HEAD --` on the five files, and `git diff HEAD` read 0 bytes.

## Verification (head `ec448f2`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (after `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`): VERDICT command-exit 0. The test project `tsconfig.test.json` compiles the tests too.
- Full app-shell project (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`) at `9a1de08`: `1336 passed | 1 failed | 1 skipped` files. The one failure was `FlowNodeInspector.requiredMarkers-10948`, which reads the http URL placeholder I had changed. `ec448f2` restores the placeholder.
- Then, at `ec448f2`, every `FlowNodeInspector*`, `FlowKeyValueField*`, `FlowNodeConfigField*`, `flowTextSlots*`, `flowValueSlots*`, `FlowRecipientsField*`, `VariableTextInput*` and `flow-node-config*` file plus `previews/simulator`: `Test Files 42 passed`, `Tests 664 passed | 1 skipped`.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `i18n-dead-keys`, `new-line-citations`, `control-bytes`, `changeset-claims`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `test-path-roots`, plus `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`. After the last commit I re-ran `designer-field-key-parity`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations` and `changeset-presence`: all exit 0.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 ("The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec …"). That is objectui#12334 on main and unrelated: this diff touches no `package.json` or changeset config.
- eslint, narrowed to the 7 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 7 files, 0 errors, and 4 `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings on `FlowKeyValueField.tsx`'s already-exported helpers. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions` project, so type-aware linting is off, and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- The held rows above (S3 `collection`, S6 CRUD `filter` operands, S4 notify `sourceId` / `templateData`, S5 http `body`, screen `recordId` / `fields[].defaultValue`) are all refused on next.0, and Studio still prescribes or inserts single-brace tokens at several of them. For example, the update_record filter help reads "id → {recordId}", and the loop / map collection placeholders and pickers are single-brace. They are left to the seat's split. objectui#12329 is the sibling for the remaining designer and simulator single-brace teaching, and it remains open.
- A stored `{token}` is not rewritten automatically. Under CEL an absent variable fails where the template wrote nothing, so the spec's refusal names both the plain and the `has()`-guarded spellings, and the author chooses.
